blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — American users of several major banking apps and online portals reported outages on Monday, according to the monitoring site Downdetector.com, with one institution ruling out a cyberattack as the cause. Among those affected by the outages were Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase and the popular money transfer app Zelle. Downdetector said outage reports peaked around 2:00 pm Eastern Standard Time (1900 GMT) before subsiding.
